fields.name: Parent_2_0E1A37CE4AF01519A9BCE6ACA2CD1137
fields.toolTip: Determines if this space object will move with the sun, moon, or not move.

fields.name: RelativeRotation_5_6AB46E784AAA14769695A882EB23223E
fields.toolTip: The rotation of the object, relative to the actor if it has no parent, or relative to the sun or moon if parented to those.

fields.name: Scale_9_D8C257DF48AA1AA6FF92B0BADA269EDB
fields.toolTip: The visual size of the planet/moon

fields.name: ColorTexture_30_2BBB70D24D2BDD9AD355609B4FF9B21B
fields.toolTip: The texture used for the color. Should be flat/unshaded.

fields.name: ColorTextureTint_123_F088C5B64DFD1D20EEC23CBC27966B9C
fields.toolTip: Tints the color texture overall

fields.name: NormalMap_33_A9266AE648B84654F7C9B9849CFA3E7C
fields.toolTip: Normal map for adding detail to shading from the sun

fields.name: NormalMapStrength_36_6F822CA84FCDEF589CED9595F668D77A
fields.toolTip: The strength of the normal map's effect on the shading.

fields.name: DarkSideTint_40_83860D2D4EEEF7086AB3AFB09CF1DCCC
fields.toolTip: The color multiplied over the dark side of the planet. Can be set to white to make an object that doesn't visibly have shading.

fields.name: LightSideTint_42_0EF08CD645E27CABBE7DBD8E7471F04B
fields.toolTip: The color multiplied over the light side of the planet. Would typically be white, but can be used to tint the light side as needed.

fields.name: TerminatorThickness_58_E6DC59F2417BA23BB1BAA5BF464BF621
fields.toolTip: Multiplied over the shading gradient, to control how wide/tight the terminator (the border between the light and dark side) is.

fields.name: TerminatorPower_60_249814CB4B2F0A60E458FEA89132D36E
fields.toolTip: An exponent for the shading gradient, to control the curve of falloff from light to dark.

fields.name: TerminatorOffset_62_E26446874807C179E62DC3A3D511938F
fields.toolTip: An offset for the shading gradient, to have more or less of the sphere be lit.

fields.name: TerminatorTint_44_8A6F729743E618D4CBE093BDCA99CD01
fields.toolTip: A tint color applied in the middle of the terminator. Useful for planets with atmospheres like Earth, to imitate the way light filters warm along the terminator.

fields.name: LightVector_105_71AFA5654C1A2915EF2F6F9636985F79
fields.toolTip: Choose the angle that the material will appear lit from. The sun, the moon, or the custom vector (adjustable below)

fields.name: CustomLightVector_108_A1E02E374DF47067FFF4BB83AD035BC4
fields.toolTip: If the Light Vector setting is Custom, this vector will be used for the direction light shades this planet.

fields.name: Glow_116_6BBE205A4CB7B5A1555103A09A90E0F7
fields.toolTip: Glow around the planet/moon, like light scattering through the local atmosphere

fields.name: GlowColor_117_D644808A49C9F262468CD988D1087F09
fields.toolTip: Tints the color of the glow added by the above setting

fields.name: GlowScale_120_20ADA5B346CD968A0904D284F1D968B0
fields.toolTip: Scales the glow sprite relative to the planet/moon scale

fields.name: RenderAtmosphere_47_8FA38C394C66F95149E4269D6A13E9DE
fields.toolTip: If true, atmosphere color and a ring of atmosphere "glow" will encircle the planet.

fields.name: AtmosphereStrength_50_0D33B16248764FF3CEBC98B70F026998
fields.toolTip: The opacity of the atmosphere color and glow

fields.name: AtmosphereThickness_52_0C2D526D4C6E998A929F2D9A2B3FE30B
fields.toolTip: The size of the atmosphere's "ring" around the planet's sphere.

fields.name: AtmosphereColor_55_39F94C30482BE08919CDB1BE025A7DC8
fields.toolTip: The color of the atmosphere, applied if Render Atmosphere is true.

fields.name: EmissiveTexture_66_5312AAA94E7A901D5F46D6AC848F943F
fields.toolTip: An emissive color texture or grayscale mask. One possible use is for city lights visible on the night side of a planet.

fields.name: EmissiveLightSideTint_73_969799654B9C1754BDE425B229EA063E
fields.toolTip: Tints the emissive texture on the lit side of the planet

fields.name: EmissiveDarkSideTint_74_EBFDD1104CC20ADAE943EC913D1977B2
fields.toolTip: Tints the emissive texture on the dark side of the planet

fields.name: RenderRing_78_1DDEF5604EC914832AB31CA1327D2947
fields.toolTip: Render planetary rings around the sphere

fields.name: RingPitch_80_56F5E8E14589B8624F3C7B9951D4C8D1
fields.toolTip: The pitch of the ring's rotation

fields.name: RingRoll_82_091721764596A286D8F56C92EFB17435
fields.toolTip: The roll of the ring's rotation

fields.name: RingDistance_84_8E87B9394476970597D7A8B81A055C39
fields.toolTip: The innter distance of the ring, from the planet surface.

fields.name: RingWidth_86_324627CE43F44BEFA03D019FC1E0FF8F
fields.toolTip: The thickness of the ring

fields.name: RingTexture_92_B962AC934EE0E4617A29BE9F710F32EF
fields.toolTip: The texture used for the ring. Only sampled on X axis, so should be 1 pixel tall. RGB contains color and A is used for opacity.

fields.name: RingTintColor_95_4F6B04E54C74C020B0C009971EB24538
fields.toolTip: Tint the color of the ring. Multiplied over the color from the Ring Texture.

fields.name: RingOpacity_98_6F398376468F51CF8289D9AA39638D49
fields.toolTip: Scales the alpha channel of the ring texture

fields.name: RingShadowBrightness_100_82A5108141E68184387C0CBDA39F37D6
fields.toolTip: Sets how much the planet's shadow darkens the ring.

fields.name: RingShadowSoftness_102_B53027E540B8F2E6C7744D90958C1B85
fields.toolTip: Larger values will make the planet's shadow on the ring softer.

fields.name: RingAroundLocalPlanet_137_C88F416041C533DC98C9EA8F7D68CBD7
fields.toolTip: This is for if you want to use this planet/moon to render a ring around the local planet (the planet you're on). When this is true, only the ring decal will be rendered, centered around the local planet.

fields.name: MeshDeformTexture_126_B7DC215A433430E4AD89459B331BC0CE
fields.toolTip: Alpha texture used to deform the surface along the vertex normal (for irregularly shaped moons, asteroids)

fields.name: MeshDeformStrength_129_CBDEB487415F39784E41DBB95BE8F4B1
fields.toolTip: Amount to deform the mesh along the vertex normal, relative to the size of the object.

fields.name: MeshDeformCenterLevel_135_D94322934BFA5C635C0D2BA54E37A086
fields.toolTip: Defines the level of brightness in the mesh deform texture which is unmoved by the deformation.

fields.name: MeshDeformTextureOffset_132_F11E46C5458E2C4E5B3ABB8E3C2E6B45
fields.toolTip: The first two channels offset the mesh deform texture in X and Y space. The third scales the texture.
